svg.title: dsh-gongwen-flow-check: one register, six rules, three states
svg.desc: A receipt-and-handling register (7 header fields plus 8 row columns) feeds six rules read from rules/gongwen-flow-check.yaml. GF-001 checks that the handler column is filled; GF-002 that receivedAt is not after doneAt; GF-003 that doneAt is not after dueAt; GF-004 that status comes from the configured values list; GF-005 that docNo appears once; GF-006 that the header declares title and receivedAt. Every gate leaves in one of three states: what it found goes to issues[] (GF-001, one warn on row 1 because handler is empty), what it could not run goes to skipped[] with its own reason (GF-004, values unset), and a rule that ran clean enters neither list (GF-002, GF-003, GF-005, GF-006). The severity rail records the real ceiling: this pack has no direct basis, so error is never emitted; principle-based rules cap at warn (four rules) and institution-configured rules cap at info (two rules). The report band carries error 0, warn 1, info 0, issueCount 1, skippedCount 1, ruleset 2026.1, markdown plus reportJson under the wording guard and disclaimer. The tool only reads file or material, never writes it, and the verdict stays with the reviewer.

svg.text: 六条规则同读一份台账：命中的进 issues[]，跑不了的进 skipped[]，跑过没命中的两栏都不进。
